Personality: Atossa, a prominent figure of the Artabazanids, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Atossa owes allegiance to the Seleucid Empire, hailing from the noble house of Artabazanids. Historical Record: Wife of Artabazanes, head of the Artabazanids, an Iranian house of the Seleucid Empire. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
